newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudis pray for rain in response to king's appeal.
newsitem.headline: Saudis pray for rain in response to king's appeal.

text.p: Saudis prayed for rain across the desert kingdom on Thursday in response to a recent appeal by King Fahd, Saudi Arabian state media reported.
Saudi television said Moslems across the country prayed for rain after delays in normal winter rainfall.
Saudi Arabia has a large agricultural sector, with big tracts of wheat and barley under cultivation.
In December, week-long freak rainstorms and gales hit the kingdom's Red Sea coastal areas, causing 90 million riyals ($24 million) in damage and killing at least three people.
The storms had followed prayers for rain in response to a previous appeal by King Fahd.
